about.title: about us
about.mission: We create real settings where high school students learn by doing: they communicate, plan and deliver projects, supported by mentors and a community that matters.
about.vision: High school students who believe they can change something around them, and know how to do it.
about.noSchools: The list of partner schools will appear here soon.

privacy.title: privacy
privacy.draftNotice: Draft text: re_form will replace it with a version approved by a legal adviser before launch.
privacy.dataBody: For accounts: name, email address, school and role. For work in the platform: the projects, files, assessments and messages you create. For the newsletter: only the email address.
privacy.minorsBody: Accounts are only created by the re_form team, with the agreement of the school and parents. There is no public sign-up.
privacy.photosBody: We only publish photos from activities once everyone who appears in them (for minors, their parents) has agreed.
privacy.messagesBody: Direct messages are private. An administrator can read one only when someone reports the conversation, and every such access is logged.
privacy.rightsBody: You can ask at any time for a copy of your data, a correction or deletion, by writing to the contact address.

invites.title: invitations
invites.introAdmin: Only invited people can get an account. You can invite students, core leads, the re_form team and admins.
invites.introStaff: Only invited people can get an account. You can invite students, core leads and colleagues from the re_form team.
invites.deliveryHint: You share the link yourself (WhatsApp, your own email) and it always leads to this site. The email is sent by Supabase and only arrives if email sending is set up.
invites.linkReady: The link for {email} is ready. Send it to this person only.
invites.linkHint: Whoever opens the link chooses a password and is signed in. If it expires, create another from the list below.
invites.noPending: No open invitations: everyone invited has set up their account.
invites.noProfileHint: Invite again with the form above and the same email, so they get a name, a role and a school.
invites.adminOnly: Only an admin can manage this invitation.
invites.orphansBody: These accounts can log in but have no profile, so they see “account blocked”. Invite them again with the form above and the same email: they get a profile and a link to set a password.
invites.emailHelpTitle: Invite emails don't arrive or lead to localhost?
invites.emailHelp1: Supabase → Authentication → URL Configuration: Site URL = this site's address; under Redirect URLs add the site's address followed by /**.
invites.emailHelp2: Supabase → Authentication → Emails → Templates: paste supabase/templates/invite.html into “Invite user” and recovery.html into “Reset password”.
invites.emailHelp3: Supabase → Authentication → Emails → SMTP: connect an email service; the built-in sender only sends a few emails an hour.
invites.emailHelp4: Until then, use “Create invite link”: it works without any of the settings above.
invites.missingKey: The server has no SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY, so it can't create accounts. Add it in Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables and redeploy.

recap.name: Event recap
recap.description: The story of an activity, with photos, a quote, a gallery and a video.
recap.h1: In short: what happened, where and with whom (2–3 sentences).
recap.h2: The best photo of the event, full width.
recap.h3: The story of the day: how it started, what students did, what came out of it.
recap.h4: A close-up photo, next to the text.
recap.h5: What participants learned. The text flows around the photo.
recap.h6: A quote from a participant (with their name).
recap.h8: A video: upload a clip or paste a YouTube, TikTok or Instagram link.

announcement.name: Event announcement
announcement.description: Poster, invitation, programme, an Instagram post and a sign-up button.
announcement.h1: The poster or an image for the event.
announcement.h2: The invitation in one sentence: what, when, for whom.
announcement.h3: The programme in short and what participants will learn.
announcement.h4: An Instagram or Facebook post about the event (paste the link).
announcement.h5: Who organises it, who the guests are, why it's worth it.
announcement.h6: When, where, what to bring, how to sign up.

digest.name: Monthly digest
digest.description: The month's news: in short, from each school, posts to watch and what's next.
digest.h1: This month's hello: what happened at re_form this month.
digest.h2: In short, 3–5 points (start each line with -).
digest.h3: A photo from the first school.
digest.h4: What the first school's team did.
digest.h5: A photo from the second school.
digest.h6: What the second school's team did.
digest.h7: Two posts or videos side by side (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Spotify).

spotlight.h1: The student's portrait (with their and their parents' consent).
spotlight.h2: Who they are, which school, which project they lead.
spotlight.h3: Their story: where the idea came from.
spotlight.h4: The best line from the interview.
spotlight.h6: The video interview (upload it or paste a YouTube link).

gallery.h2: The main video (YouTube, Vimeo or uploaded).
gallery.h4: A few words about the moments captured.
gallery.h5: Instagram or TikTok posts side by side.
gallery.h7: Thanks: who took photos, who filmed, the partners.
